problem: Calculate the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\text{u}=⟨0,2⟩$ and $\text{v}=⟨3,3⟩.$
worked_solution:
First, we construct a matrix where the columns are made up of the components of the corresponding vectors:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

Then, we find the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(M) & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =0\cdot 3-3\cdot 2 \\  & =-6\end{aligned}
$$

The absolute value of $det(M)$ gives the area $A$ of the parallelogram:

$$
A=|-6\,|=6
$$
